Title: Manoj and the Family

Cast

1. Manoj - 35 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Shalini - 64 years, mother
Look: red salwar-kameez

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Manoj stands in the living room. Shalini stands near him.]

Manoj: "Let's do something fun today."

[Manoj pours himself a whisky and drinks it.]

Manoj: "Let's see."

[Manoj sips red wine.]

Manoj: "I'm ready!"

[Manoj drinks a beer.]

Shalini (gently): "Careful!"

[Manoj staggers drunkenly towards the door.]

Shalini: "Yes, all right."

[Manoj and Mother clink their glasses.]

Manoj: "Look at this."

[Manoj walks slowly across the room while talking on the phone.]

Manoj: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Manoj stands on the road. Shalini stands near him.]

Shalini: "What a nice place."

[Manoj starts the car, turns the steering wheel and drives off.]

Manoj: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Manoj is driving when he slams on the brakes.]

Manoj: "Hmm, I see."

[Manoj steps on the accelerator and speeds away in his car.]

Manoj: "I really enjoyed today."
